disposition_reason: Inspectible complete source scores genuine held-video neural responses under a conditional VersionB estimator with protected fixed references. All actual data/source/runtime and numerical qualification gates remain open; the source is inactive.

scientific_target.question: How accurately do candidate dynamic/motion/category representations predict the released joint VersionB response measurement over complete grouped video folds, relative to independently generated fixed static and dynamic references?
scientific_target.known_answer: Private released joint GLMsingle VersionB unnormalized response coordinates for each participant/video/ROI; all candidate/reference comparisons use the identical targets and fold joins.
scientific_target.answer_origin: The released jointly fitted response estimator, conditional on its upstream estimation. Downstream training-only processing cannot make that upstream measurement independently held out.
scientific_target.case_unit: Participant × outer-fold view; scoring combines all1102 held-video predictions into each of460 participant/ROI cells.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Ten participants crossed with source video-equivalence groups; ROIs, repeats, folds and coordinate counts are not independent people.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Conditional neural response prediction and matched representation comparison; temporal-control advantage is descriptive information evidence, not proof of action dynamics understanding.
exclusions: Independent raw-measurement or held-person transfer validation.
A newly hidden benchmark from the exposed published102 test videos.

inputs: Training response coordinates from released joint VersionB, independently fixed fsLR32k ROI masks, training/query videos and declared dynamic/static/motion/category features.
Eight mandatory model/control feature views with identical selection budget and nested training-only fitting.
forbidden_inputs: Query neural responses, task-response-selected masks/coordinates, query-fitted normalization/PCA/layer/alpha.
Evaluator-owned reference outputs before candidate closure and shared-video target lookup.
observation_contract.case_identity: Symbolic sub-01...sub-10 and vid0001...vid1102 are vocabulary, not populated authentic IDs. Source requires exact source/coordinate/split and reference bindings for each50 view.
observation_contract.split: Five grouped outer and five inner folds across all1102 videos; all repeats and source-equivalent stimuli stay together. Source groups must include shared EEGMoments stimuli and pretraining exposure.
observation_contract.coverage: Ten people,1102 videos,40200 trials,46 bilateral ROIs,50 views and460 cells, eight models, two programme modes and three arms. Missing any mandatory cell prevents complete aggregation; conditions are not new tasks.

primary.name: Raw unclipped candidate dynamic_motion_category R²
primary.aggregation: Per-coordinate held-video R², mean coordinates within ROI, then equal46 ROIs and equal ten people only if all460 cells and mandatory model/reference scores are defined.
primary.rationale: Directly rewards neural response prediction quality; evaluator-owned fixed references prevent gaming a candidate-controlled subtraction baseline.

secondary: Paired candidate-minus-fixed static_motion_category and dynamic_motion_category R² vectors and aggregates.
Candidate dynamic-minus-own-static only descriptive, never reward/pass criterion.
All eight candidate/control predictions, full460-cell failures and shared resampling summaries.

comparators.name: Protected fixed static_motion_category
comparators.inputs: Same training responses/query features, fixed source and training-only inner selection.
comparators.procedure: Evaluator invokes original reference Engine once per50 view; exact immutable capture/source/target join is mandatory.

comparators.name: Protected fixed dynamic_motion_category
comparators.inputs: Same observations and training-only layer/alpha/PCA policy as the static reference.
comparators.procedure: Independently generated reference rather than candidate-supplied baseline; complete identical coordinate/video support.

comparators.name: Mandatory static/motion/temporal controls
comparators.inputs: Static center, mean, orderless; motion only; shuffled and reversed dynamics plus matched category.
comparators.procedure: All eight models emitted under matched fitting budgets; unfavorable temporal contrasts retained.

nuisance_controls: Freeze independent bilateral ROI and coordinate producers before task response access.
Label the released jointly fitted GLMsingle estimator explicitly.
Training-only normalization/PCA/readout choice does not repair upstream measurement dependence.
Source-equivalence groups and shared stimulus/pretraining exposure cannot be replaced with random video folds.
evaluation.uncertainty: Shared participant/source-group resamples across primary and both fixed-reference families; three separate46-ROI multiplicity families. Intervals remain descriptive until ten-person calibration; undefined required resamples block intervals.
evaluation.failure_policy: Exact all50 joins/all1102 out-of-fold videos/all46 ROIs/all8 models and both fixed references are mandatory. Nonfinite/constant-target coordinates make the required cell undefined; complete aggregate is null, not silently filtered or clipped. Intended finite-score admission remains an implementation gap: current coordinate_scores checks input finiteness but does not reject residual-square overflow before marking the result defined.

implementation.scorer_target: scorer.py reads targets only after actor closure and exact immutable prediction/reference bindings; metrics.py scores held-video response arrays and mandatory controls. This is genuine neural response prediction, distinct from its separately retained literal_a source reconstruction.
implementation.delivered_scope: Full inactive preparation/reference/scorer/transport programme source with explicit conditional measurement and source-only vocabulary. No active central programme selection or authentic roster is supplied. Its adaptive-named condition consumes operator-supplied source sequences; live agent investigation is not delivered.
missing: VersionB producer compatibility including motion-energy mat73/scipy representation.
Immutable environment/model locks, protected full source execution, numerical parity and uncertainty calibration.

Finite metric arithmetic/output admission: coordinate_scores checks finite inputs but finite extreme predictions can overflow squared residuals to infinite R²; native numerical validation remains unresolved.
implementation.execution_evidence: Source README and manifest report not_run and all28 qualification gates open. This revision inspected actual scoring/reference paths; no native data or model was executed.

direct_observation.representation: A video/stimulus observation and training response examples with predicted held-out neural responses; the current high-dimensional encoding endpoint has no direct observation packet.
direct_observation.boundary: No evaluator targets, source-label lookup, other-case memory or model/numerical tools; a direct response is evaluated separately from programme results.
missing: Authentic complete observation presentation and no-tools response collection have not been delivered.

typed_viewer.representation: Proposed typed navigation over the permitted stimulus and training-response representations.

missing: Task-specific renderer/action API, complete case collection and restrictive transport are absent.

tool_assisted.representation: The declared adaptive condition accepts a finite operator-captured per-case source sequence. It does not implement live agent authoring or a numerical-tool observation/feedback loop.
tool_assisted.boundary: Do not equate a condition name or sequence of source replacements with an interactive investigation. A future matched agent transport must enforce the same query, target and resource boundary.

frozen_program.boundary: Freeze before query access; equal declared calibration and no post-query selection from evaluator feedback. Programme success does not measure unaided interpretation.
missing: Exact environment, source/data joins and complete execution qualification are outstanding.
